pr_title: Use Stop button on (production) buildings to reset rally point fixes …
pr_body:
Fixes #20414

This PR adds the stop button to all buildings which can have a rally point. You now can use the Stop button to clear the rally point.

The Stop button remains active even if there isn't a rally point set. This is consistent with vehicles or infantry which have the Stop button active at all times, even if they are stopped at the moment. 
Also don't checking if the Stop button should be active everytime we're switching actors saves us a few cpu cycles.

issue_context.title: Issue stop command on production buildings to reset rally points
issue_context.body: In the original Red Alert 2, you can reset a production building's rally point by issuing a stop command on it. This is useful if you misclicked with a rally point or you want to change the rally point and reset it instead of setting it near the building yourself.
comments:
@MikillRosen I've got two ways to do that.
The first one would be to allow the Stop Button on all Production Buildings at all times - this is just a minor change in the yaml Files. The downside is that the Stop Button is also active at all times - even when there is no Rally Point set. I do not see this as a problem because with units it's the same. You can click the stop Button even if they are already stopped. Simply nothing will happen and we will be consistent with this approach.

The other way would be to activate the Stop Button in OpenRA.Mods.Common/Widgets/Logic/Ingame/CommandBarLogic.cs:304 - so it will be activated when we're switching to an Actor/Building which has a Rally Point set at the moment. This avoids changing anything in the yaml file BUT it will change a few (more) lines of code, adding another test everytime you switch Actors and also we need to activate the Stop Button right after setting the Rallypoint, presumably in RallyPoint.cs - which is also not that nice.

What do you think?
I'll go with the first one, but what do people think?
